integrity: All claims are based on the accompanying analytic proof; the independent, executable finite calculations are supplementary. No independent external audit, absolute publication-priority determination, or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite fixed acyclic delegation forests; independent binary guru votes and fair ties. General results require potentially many nodes and unbounded branching. The small-order theorem concerns independent guru competencies and a strict interior advantage over both endpoints; no assumption about correlated ballots or strategic changes is made.
title: Polynomial universality and disconnected optimal viscosity in two-guru delegation forests
